claims: The NASA Artemis II rocket launched successfully on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Space Launch System (SLS) propelled four astronauts toward the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to travel around the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II crew is now in Earth orbit.
The Artemis II mission blasted off from Launch Pad 39B.
Spectators in Florida saw the rocket ascend.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew is currently conducting a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission achieved successful orbital insertion.
The Artemis II crew is safely in orbit.
There were earlier minor technical concerns with the flight termination system.
The minor technical concerns with the flight termination system were resolved prior to lift-off.
